name: meow-ghostel-compile
comment: ghostel-compile with compilation-scroll-output nil: point stays parked at the top of the buffer in insert state. The output is short, so the window shows the live cursor and counts as following; only the ghostel-inhibit-anchor-functions veto keeps the redraw advice from dragging point to it.

steps.comment: point and window-point stay at the top while the run is live

steps.eval: (ghostel-compile "echo aa; echo bb; echo doneXY; sleep 20")

(with-current-buffer "*ghostel-compile*" (let ((w (get-buffer-window (current-buffer) t))) (unless (and meow-ghostel-mode (meow-insert-mode-p) w (ghostel--window-anchored-p w)) (error "PRECONDITION mode %S state %S window %S" meow-ghostel-mode (meow--current-state) w)) (unless (and (= 1 (point)) (= 1 (window-point w))) (error "DRAGGED point %d window-point %d cursor %S" (point) (window-point w) ghostel--cursor-char-pos))))
